record.edic_text:
5513 chliaros {khlee-ar-os'}

from chlio (to warm); TDNT - 2:876,296; adj

AV - lukewarm 1; 1

1) tepid, lukewarm
2) metaph. of the condition of the soul wretchedly fluctuating
   between a torpor and a fervour of love
